sections.heading: About Us
sections.content:
Our Institute has started a new course B.E in -Artificial Intelligence and Data Science in the Academic year 2020-2021.
Highlights of The Department:
Artificial Intelligence and Data Science is one of the emerging areas out of 10 special categories identified by AICTE and MHRD which can meet the upcoming requirements of the Industrial Revolution. Artificial Intelligence is a major step forward in how computer system adapts, evolves and learns. It has widespread application in almost every industry and is considered to be a big technological shift, similar in scale to past events such as the industrial revolution, the computer age, and the smart phone revolution.
The course covers the core principles of Data Science, the process of ethically acquiring,  engineering, analyzing, visualizing and ultimately monetizing data. It equips it with the basic tools and techniques of data handling, exploratory data analysis, data visualization and data-based inference.
Aims to train students in the rapidly growing field of Artificial Intelligence & Data Science, to be vibrant Research Hub in this area 1. Includes Advanced Laboratory Facilities, Industry Institute Research Collaborations. 2. Impart knowledge sharing by Domain Experts, Value Added Courses, Collaborative Learning with Reputed Universities in India and Abroad.
Salient Features of the Course
Artificial Intelligence (AI) deals with the intelligence demonstrated by machines to design solutions to problems by observing the environmental changes. ii. Data Science (DS) deals with the analysis of huge volume of data to reveal hidden patterns and correlations to get new insights. iii. One among the most demanding, highest paid job and future scope of IT & Telecom industry. iv. Applications like Alexa/Siri, Erica/Sophia, Teslaâ€™s driverless car, Chatbot etc are becoming common. v. AI powered Robots can take over human life endangering jobs like firefighting, deep sea oil drilling, mining works with high mortality rate etc.
This course is for the students who want toâ€¦
– Acquire the ability to design intelligent solutions to problems in a variety of domains – Create cutting edge AI Applications – Have a career with exceptional prospective fields and challenging roles in a futuristic industry
* Career path after the course:
Some of the leading roles that can be chosen for career are: – Machine Learning Engineer – Technology Officer – Data Scientist – Business Analyst – Artificial Intelligence Engineer – Software Engineer – Data Analyst – Network Administrator – Machine Learning Architect – Webmaster & Technocrat – Database Administrator
Strengths of the Department
- Aims to train students in the rapidly growing field of Artificial Intelligence & Data Science, to be vibrant Research Hub in this area Includes Advanced Laboratory Facilities, Industry Institute Research Collaborations.
- Impart knowledge sharing by Domain Experts, Value Added Courses, Collaborative Learning with Reputed Universities in India and Abroad.
- Highly qualified and experienced faculty with expertise in AI, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, IoT, Cybersecurity, and Data Analytics.
- State-of-the-art laboratories and computing facilities for hands-on learning and research.
- Industry collaborations, internships, and certification programs to bridge the gap between academia and industry.
- Strong focus on research, innovation, and entrepreneurship through projects, hackathons, and publications.
- Holistic student development through technical, professional, and co-curricular activities.
- Strengthen industry tie-ups for internships, projects, and placements specifically in AI & DS domains such as Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, Big Data, and Predictive Analytics.
- Introduce certification programs and workshops led by industry experts to augment academic curriculum (e.g. in cloud services, AI toolkits, ethical AI).
- Increase student participation in competitions, hackathons, R&D projects, and publications.
- Upgrade laboratory infrastructure and computational resources (GPUs, cloud credits) to support hands-on learning and experimentation.
- To establish the department as a Centre of Excellence in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science.
- To promote interdisciplinary research leading to patents, publications, and innovative solutions for society.
- To develop strong global collaborations with universities and research organizations.
- To contribute to national missions in AI, Digital India, and Industry 4.0 through student and faculty research.
- To nurture graduates who are not only technically proficient but also ethically responsible and socially committed.
- Data Scientist / Data Analyst – analyzing and interpreting complex data to aid decision-making.
- Machine Learning Engineer – designing, training, and deploying ML models for real-world applications.
- AI Engineer – developing AI systems for speech, vision, robotics, healthcare, and automation.
- Business Intelligence (BI) Developer – transforming data into actionable insights for organizations.
- Big Data Engineer – handling large-scale data processing, storage, and retrieval systems.
- Natural Language Processing (NLP) Specialist – working with speech recognition, chatbots, and text analytics.
- Computer Vision Engineer – developing vision-based applications for security, healthcare, AR/VR, and autonomous systems.
- Cloud & DevOps Engineer – implementing AI and DS solutions using cloud platforms and scalable infrastructures.
- AI Product Manager / Consultant – bridging technology and business to deliver AI-driven products and solutions.
- Researcher / Innovator – contributing to R&D, patents, and academic advancements in AI & DS.
Higher Education & Research
Students can also pursue postgraduate studies (M.Tech/MS/PhD) in AI, Machine Learning, Data Science, or allied areas at reputed national and international universities, opening pathways for teaching, advanced research, and entrepreneurship .
Industry Domains Hiring AI & DS Graduates
- IT Services & Consulting
- Finance & Banking (FinTech)
- Healthcare & Bioinformatics
- E-Commerce & Retail
- Manufacturing & Industry 4.0
- Smart Cities, IoT & Automation
- Cybersecurity & Defense
- Entertainment, Media & Gaming
